theme: Writing hurricane policies that do not all fail together
title: Storm-Correlated Underwriting
strategies: price-adequacy-only greedy (ignores footprint correlation and accumulation limits)
safe capacity-respecting greedy (never breaches any storm limit, forgoes profitable overage)
iterative marginal-value / exchange greedy that recomputes each candidate's value against the current book (exploits the convex per-storm accumulation-limit cost and steers around crowded footprints)
